description: Call before opening or updating a pull request: the ids (captain facts, reviewFirst hunks, check questions) from the review brief that a pre-PR self-check should fix or explain. Fix the diff, or write a one-line reason (<=140 chars) it does not need fixing, for each one; when an id names a real, unresolved problem you can't fix yourself right now, mark it needs-fix with a one-line reason instead, then write your verdicts as a JSON array into your head commit's own message inside a `<!-- opendrs-self-check:v1 ... -->` block (e.g. [{"id":"<id>","verdict":"fixed"},{"id":"<id>","verdict":"explained","note":"<why>"},{"id":"<id>","verdict":"needs-fix","note":"<why>"}]). Advisory only: never part of the auto-approve gate or the captain's priority.

base.description: Base ref to diff against. Defaults to "origin/HEAD", or "main" when that is not set.

head.description: Head ref to score. Defaults to "HEAD".

maxTokens.description: Token budget for the underlying brief (default 2500, min 300, max 6000).

repoDir.description: Absolute path to the git repository (any directory inside the work tree).

name: self_check_items
